hostname.description: Fully qualified domain name of the FreeIPA server (e.g., ipa1.example.com)

ldap_port.description: LDAP port. Use 636 for LDAPS or 389 for STARTTLS

ldap_bind_dn.description: Distinguished Name for LDAP bind (e.g., uid=ldap-lookup,cn=users,cn=accounts,dc=example,dc=com). Not required when Kerberos is enabled.

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for the LDAP bind account. Not required when Kerberos is enabled.

ldap_base_dn.description: Base DN for the FreeIPA domain (e.g., dc=example,dc=com)

ldap_timeout.description: Timeout for LDAP connections and operations

ldap_ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate file for LDAPS verification (e.g., /etc/ipa/ca.crt). Leave empty to use system CA store.

use_kerberos.description: Use Kerberos keytab for LDAP GSSAPI bind and IPA JSON-RPC API authentication. When enabled, LDAP bind password is not required.

kerberos_keytab_path.description: Path to keytab file for Kerberos authentication

kerberos_principal.description: Kerberos principal to authenticate as (e.g., monitor@EXAMPLE.COM)

ipa_api_password.description: Password for IPA JSON-RPC API authentication (alternative to Kerberos). Uses the same user as the LDAP bind DN uid.

enable_services.description: Monitor status of FreeIPA services (LDAP, KDC, httpd, CA, DNS)

enable_ldap_metrics.description: Collect LDAP performance metrics from cn=monitor

enable_replication.description: Monitor replication agreement status, lag, and conflicts

enable_dns.description: Monitor DNS zones and SRV records

enable_certificates.description: Monitor certificate expiration and tracking status

enable_healthcheck.description: Run ipa-healthcheck and report results (local/OneAgent mode only)

polling_interval.description: How often to collect metrics. Minimum 60 seconds, recommended 300 for entity keepalive.
